installCommand: sh -c 'if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then env -u npm_config_cache_dir -u NPM_CONFIG_CACHE_DIR npm ci; else env -u npm_config_cache_dir -u NPM_CONFIG_CACHE_DIR npm install; fi'
buildCommand: env -u npm_config_cache_dir -u NPM_CONFIG_CACHE_DIR npm run build
ignoreCommand: sh -c 'case $VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF in dependabot/*) exit 0;; esac; git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- . ../packages/shared && exit 0 || exit 1'
